description: This file contains interface definitions for grains and observers in an Orleans application, specifically for testing purposes. It defines interfaces for observable grains and their observers, including subscription methods and state change notifications.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Method to subscribe an observer to the grain.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Method to unsubscribe an observer from the grain.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Method to retrieve the runtime instance ID of the grain.

methods.name: StateChanged
methods.description: Observer method invoked when the state changes.
